ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed MDIA 370 Sales and the Consumer (SP 66016 FA 66561) should not register for ADV 370. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. ADV 270 is *not* required for this course. For questions, please contact the instructor at dclifton@illinois.edu. This course is taught asynchronously.
